convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for a non-standard indicator (ColorSchaffDeMarkerTrendCycle) and depends on external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library for all trade execution and money management logic, which must be manually reimplemented.

TimeShiftSec - timeframe duration in seconds
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime calculation for trade execution timing

DnSignalTime - timestamp for sell signal bar end

other_exits: Buy closed when Color[1]<2 (indicator in sell zone) and BuyPosClose enabled
Sell closed when Color[1]>5 (indicator in buy zone) and SellPosClose enabled

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum determines sizing method: LOT=fixed lot size (MM=0.1), FREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin, BALANCE=fraction of balance, LOSSFREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin minus loss, LOSSBALANCE=fraction of balance minus loss. The MM input (0.1) serves as either lot size or percentage fraction depending on MMMode.

custom_logic_notes: The indicator uses buffer index 1 (color/trend buffer) with integer-coded zones: values >5 indicate bullish zone, values <2 indicate bearish zone, values 2-5 are neutral/transition. Entry requires both a prior-bar zone signal (Color[1] in zone) AND a confirmation from the current reference bar (Color[0] crossing the zone threshold). Buy entry: Color[1]>5 AND Color[0]<6 (i.e., still in buy zone). Sell entry: Color[1]<2 AND Color[0]>1 (still in sell zone). SignalBar=1 means signals are read from bar[1] (previous completed bar) by default. When SignalBar=0, the EA processes every tick without waiting for a new bar. The BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/BuyPosClose/SellPosClose booleans act as master switches to independently enable/disable each trade direction and close-on-reversal logic. TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose functions that encapsulate all order sending, position checking, and lot calculation - these must be fully reimplemented.
python_conversion_notes: The ColorSchaffDeMarkerTrendCycle custom indicator must be fully reimplemented in Python - it is a Schaff Trend Cycle variant applied to DeMarker oscillator. The indicator has two buffers; buffer 1 encodes trend direction as integer color codes (>5=bullish, <2=bearish). TradeAlgorithms.mqh must be reimplemented: it provides 5 key functions (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, GlobalVariableDel_) plus the MarginMode enum and CIsNewBar class. The MarginMode enum supports 5 money management modes. SL/TP are in points (not pips) - verify whether 1000/2000 need digit-adjustment for 5-digit brokers (likely yes, effectively 100/200 pips for 5-digit). The new-bar guard uses CIsNewBar class from TradeAlgorithms.mqh. Signal timing uses UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime derived from bar end time, suggesting trades may be intended for next-bar-open execution.
